hooks.name: format-and-test-swift-on-save
hooks.description: Format Swift sources and run GhostNotes unit tests after Kiro saves a Swift file.

action.command: set -o pipefail; swift-format format --in-place --recursive GhostNotes GhostNotesTests; xcodebuild test -project GhostNotes.xcodeproj -scheme GhostNotes -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'
